description: Implementation of the du_cell_stop_procedure class, managing the stopping of a cell and associated UEs in a 5G network component.

classes.name: du_cell_stop_procedure
classes.description: Class responsible for stopping a cell and managing UEs during the process.

methods.name: du_cell_stop_procedure::operator()
methods.description: Main procedure to stop a cell, wait for UEs to detach, and ensure proper cleanup.

methods.name: du_cell_stop_procedure::force_ue_removal
methods.description: Forces removal of UEs associated with the cell, optionally triggering F1 reset.

methods.name: du_cell_stop_procedure::rem_ues_with_matching_pcell
methods.description: Handles UEs release process, either via CU request or direct reset.

methods.name: du_cell_stop_procedure::await_cu_to_release_ues
methods.description: Waits for UEs to be released by CU, with timeout and fallback to force removal.
